detail.longDescription: I built handup, an approval inbox for AI coding agents. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, omp or any MCP client sends the real command, diff or email draft. I approve, or deny with a reason, from the terminal, desktop or phone, and the agent reads my answer. Not a sandbox, just a place to look before saying yes. Proprietary and paid: 14-day free trial, no signup, then $30 once. https:// gethandup.dev/?utm_source=mast odon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch-nov # AIAgents # DevTools
